'''Gilded Hellstone''' is the renamed nether gold ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla nether gold ore in [[Hell]].

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 2–6 gold nuggets; adamant tools drop a gold ingot. Can be blasted into a gold ingot. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/nether_gold_ore.json}}</ref>
